answer: A clone costs a keypair and nothing more, so the gate must be something a keypair cannot fake: real machine time. Each agent signs a receipt derived from its measured kernel image and boot hash. Ten thousand sock puppets on one laptop share one boot hash, so their receipts fold into a single identity. Weight influence by distinct boot hashes rather than addresses and the paper crowd evaporates, while honest operators thicken like a hive filling with nectar, trip by trip. Fraudsters stay stranded in a shallow lagoon of their own making, unable to deepen it without buying silicon.
